title: tools-1
description: Every hexdocs command and MCP tool, derived from the registry. Read by zero-dependency guards.

commands.name: doctor
commands.summary: Run every check that applies to this repository and report what is wrong.

commands.name: check
commands.summary: Check a documentation tree: structure, house style, links, nav and translations.

commands.name: pages
commands.summary: List every page with its translation state in every language.

commands.name: page
commands.summary: Read one page in one language, as markdown or as the compiled AST.

commands.name: bundle
commands.summary: Verify a compiled bundle, describe what is in it, and diff it against another.

commands.name: label
commands.summary: Check that a commit is safe to label as a version, and return the edit.

commands.name: scaffold
commands.summary: Return the files a repository needs, for the agent to apply. Writes nothing.

commands.name: skills
commands.summary: Return the bundled hexdocs skills: the instructions for using this toolchain.

commands.name: verify-install
commands.summary: Check that a consuming website is wired for a docs mount.

commands.name: init
commands.summary: Set up a documentation source in an app repository, and wire its public mirror.

commands.name: build
commands.summary: Compile a documentation tree and write the bundle to a directory.

commands.name: install
commands.summary: Wire a consuming website for a docs mount, or print what that would take.

commands.name: sync
commands.summary: Write the page list and the bundle digests back into a site config.

commands.name: publish
commands.summary: Upload a compiled bundle to its commit-addressed prefix, once.

commands.name: prefetch
commands.summary: Download every labelled bundle a site declares and write it into the site.

commands.name: mcp
commands.summary: Serve the hexdocs read-only tools over stdio as an MCP server.
